subject: unanswered texts
caption: Be honest, which one are you? The overthinker and the drafter are the same person with different confidence levels.

beats.text: There are four types of person, and they all handle an awkward text differently.
You answer in nine seconds so nobody can be annoyed with you.
You draft it eleven times and send it three days later.
You decide the conversation ended itself.
You write the perfect reply. You never send it. It lives in your head forever.
An unanswered message is usually not rejection. It's just a phone face down.
Follow for the stuff nobody teaches you.
